retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle group portrait framed by torn black borders and aggressive hand-drawn typography for an urban, confrontational aesthetic.
excludeWhen: high-angle or eye-level perspectives are required
minimalist or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A circle of figures looking down at the camera from a low-angle perspective, framed by jagged black paper-tear textures at the top and bottom. The sky forms a central blue negative space, while bold, distressed hand-painted lettering dominates the upper and lower margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry of subjects pointing toward a central sky focal point
Contrast between the organic, jagged black borders and the smooth blue sky
Dominance of the top red title against the dark clothing of the subjects
Confrontational eye contact from subjects looking down at the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are arranged in a ring around the perimeter of the frame, appearing large and imposing due to the low angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central patch of blue sky acts as the compositional anchor, drawing the eye inward before it moves to the faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central sky, moves outward to the faces, then upward to the red title and downward to the white subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides a circular negative space in the center, while the black torn borders provide heavy negative space at the top and bottom.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark foreground figures and bright central sky; high saturation on the red title.

letterConstructionRules: Visible brush stroke textures and drips
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have jagged, uneven edges to mimic street graffiti or quick painting
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, large red hand-painted title paired with a smaller, more legible white distressed subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, hand-painted brush stroke feel.
Provides a similar distressed, horror-adjacent urban vibe.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle worm's eye view photograph of a group of 5-6 men in 90s streetwear standing in a circle looking down at the camera. The center of the frame is a clear blue sky. Apply jagged, torn black paper borders to the top and bottom edges of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-painted red title in the top black border area, slightly overlapping the heads of the subjects. Add a smaller, white distressed sans-serif subtitle in the bottom black border area.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle extremely low looking up?
Are there torn paper textures at the top and bottom?
Is the main title red and hand-drawn in appearance?
Is the central sky visible between the subjects?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the circle
Color of the central sky (e.g., sunset, overcast)
Intensity of the torn paper texture
mustRedesign: Specific faces of the original artists
Exact letterforms of the original logo
postGenerationChecks: Check for radial symmetry in the composition
Ensure the red title is the most saturated element
Verify the torn edges look organic and not geometric
Confirm the subjects' expressions are serious or confrontational
Ensure the sky is the brightest part of the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle group circle + torn paper borders + aggressive hand-painted typography = Urban Confrontational Aesthetic.
